summary: All five phases of schemas-package plan 2/5 delivered their stated objectives, respected their excluded scope, and matched their planned commit subject/body, verified directly against git history and the current worktree state. Every file-plan deviation (three unplanned files across phase-01 and phase-02, plus one planned-but-untouched file in phase-05) is explicitly recorded and justified in its phase's handoff, and independent verification of the two highest-stakes claims — phase-05's untouched pnpm-lock.yaml and the ajv/knip.json cleanup loop opened in phase-01 and closed in phase-05 — confirms the handoffs' account. No unmet test or artifact promises were found, and no boundary-contract violation was observed.

findings.message: Literal fallback in defineFormat, five frozen v1 modules, formats/runDirectory.ts, and the BranchNameSchema jsonSchema pattern annotation are all present and pinned in history.lock.json, matching the plan exactly.

Two unplanned files touched (scripts/survey-format-shapes.ts for a pre-existing lint fix with identical output, and deno.lock rewritten mechanically by a gate), both explicitly justified in the handoff.
knip.json was edited to add ajv to ignoreDependencies with an explicit note that phase-05 must remove it; independently verified that phase-05 did remove it.
One fixture (phase-status commitHash signature) was substituted from a steme-lab example to a ~/.phax/archive document because reading steme-lab required approval; disclosed in the handoff.
shapes.test.ts, runDirectoryFormats.test.ts, branded.test.ts (optional), and parse.test.ts all exist and are non-empty, matching the planned test strategy.
Commit 2fa9c90a subject/body match the plan's 'feat(schemas-package): read every run-directory format with its history'.
Handoff covers the fallback rule, BranchNameSchema pattern, admission strategy, fixture locators, export names, and all deviations with reasons.
Four repository formats, four frozen v1 twins, and the traceability-filter jsonSchema description annotation are all present, matching the plan.

tests/unit/artifactNamesGuard.test.ts was edited (unplanned) to skip tests/unit/schemasPackage/fixtures/, because real pre-migration-path fixtures from phase-01 started failing a tracked-file naming guard once committed. Justified and disclosed.
repositoryFormats.test.ts and specDocument.test.ts (optional) both present and non-empty.
specDocument.ts retains ownership of the traceability rule; the package only wraps it, per the declared boundary contract.
Commit 0bffb8ac subject/body match the plan's 'feat(schemas-package): read approvals ledgers and spec and plan documents'.
Handoff documents the additive-only phax artifact schema spec output change, fixture locators including the empty-ledger commit, and the guard-skip deviation with its cause.

authoring-record-manifest format with sourceSha-optional frozen twin, parseRecordManifest's $schema-then-kind dispatch, and the unchanged move of the phase-record-manifest definition are all delivered as planned.
No unplanned or missing files; all planned files touched, optional files left untouched.
recordManifests.test.ts present and non-empty.
RecordManifestSchema, decodeRecordManifest and isAuthoringRecordManifest remain owned by src/schemas/authoringRecord.ts; the package only re-exports and wraps, per the declared contract.
Commit bfb8385e subject/body match the plan's 'feat(schemas-package): read the authoring record manifest and any record manifest'.
Handoff records dispatch order, failure messages, fixture commit SHAs, and a disclosed process workaround for git access restrictions in the records clone (not a scope deviation).
The v0 unversioned-shape rule, four frozen v0 modules, formats/recordTimeline.ts, and parseDocument covering all 15 FORMAT_IDS are all delivered as planned.
No unplanned files; optional document.ts was edited (message text only) and optional surveyedFixtures.ts left untouched, both within the plan's optional-file allowance.
recordTimeline.test.ts present and non-empty.
Producer modules (gateAttribution.ts, reconciliation.ts, gateDiagnostics.ts, gatePending.ts) keep ownership of current schemas and excess-property settings, per the declared contract.
Commit 96079b4c subject/body match the plan's 'feat(schemas-package): read a record's timeline files as unversioned shape v0'.

Handoff records the v0 rule, the five-signature reconciliation admission with no unexpected renames variant, real fixture sources with exact commit SHA, and a disclosed by-design divergence that never triggers on real phax output.

Independently verified: packages/schemas/json/ contains exactly 16 .schema.json files, the gap detector and renderer exist in build/jsonSchemas.ts, scripts/schemas-json.ts is wired into the root build script, parseDocument's completeness is pinned via EveryFormat<...> plus a type-level Equals assertion, and the closure guard is an exact 18-entry allowlist confirmed present in architecturalGuards.test.ts.

pnpm-lock.yaml was planned as an edit target but not touched. Independently verified via git show --stat on commit 2bfdc480 (not in the changed-file list) and via the handoff's explanation that ajv@8.20.0 was already a locked devDependency, so pnpm add -D ajv was a no-op on the lockfile. Legitimate non-deviation, but worth flagging for a future audit reading the planned-files list literally.
ajv independently confirmed removed from knip.json's ignoreDependencies, closing the follow-up phase-01 explicitly flagged.
jsonSchemas.test.ts, manifest.test.ts, architecturalGuards.test.ts, exports.test.ts, parseDocument.test.ts, and tests/type/schemasPackage.ts all present and non-empty.
The renderer takes each format's schema directly from its formats/*.ts definition, the same value its parse function decodes with, matching the declared producer/consumer contract.

Commit 2bfdc480 subject/body match the plan's 'feat(schemas-package): ship one draft-07 JSON Schema per format and fail on gaps'; the 14 actually-changed files line up with the plan minus the justified pnpm-lock.yaml exception.

Handoff records the JSONSchema.fromAST/additionalPropertiesStrategy substitution for JSONSchema.make (installed Effect lacks the needed option), the gap detector's rules with no unexpected gap found, the final closure allowlist, and the pnpm-lock.yaml non-deviation with reasoning.

attentionPoints: pnpm-lock.yaml was planned as an edit target in phase-05 but never touched; verified legitimate (ajv was already locked at the correct version), but should be flagged so the planned-files list isn't read as a broken promise on a later audit.

tests/unit/artifactNamesGuard.test.ts (phase-02) and knip.json (phase-01/phase-05) were adjusted outside the plan to accommodate the plan's own fixture-realism requirement and its own dev-dependency addition; both are narrow, disclosed, and self-consistent across phases.

This review verified file presence, exports, commit contents, and configuration state directly, but did not execute the test suite or the build itself; a full pnpm check:full run would give stronger confidence but is outside the scope of a conformance-only review.
